notes: The phrase's single *the* goes to the article standing on הָעֶלְיוֹן, the construct מוֹצָא taking none: a present article morpheme takes the written *the* before a supplied one (rule 47).
לְמַטָּה fuses into *down* under rule 30, headed on the lexeme-bearing morpheme, while the directive he on מַעְרָבָה takes the separate written *on* under rule 32.
*This same* realizes the pronoun הוּא, the referent's own name being written in the clause (rule 18).
